video_title: Catching Up With Jayson Tatum at Media Day 🗣️

quotes.speaker: Jayson Tatum
quotes.text: I never had to miss the game of basketball before in my life. And you know, just 12 months ago this time, there was just a lot of uncertainty. I didn't know if I was coming back last year or if if I did know I didn't know when. And that was just a that was a tough spot to be in, obviously because how much I love the game and love being on this team. And you know, just it just kind of put me in a spot where, you know, I had to you know, do some reflecting and you know, just really take a deep dive into you know, maybe the mental aspect of it.
quotes.pull_quote: I never had to miss the game of basketball before in my life.
quotes.news_angle: Jayson Tatum reflects on the mental challenge of recovering from his injury last season.
quotes.social_post: Jayson Tatum says the uncertainty of his injury recovery last season forced him to take a deep dive into the mental aspect of the game.

quotes.speaker: Jayson Tatum
quotes.text: Anytime you go through something that is traumatic like that, you you can't be the same person, right? I learned things about myself. I went through things that I didn't know that I could get through. I didn't know I was mentally and physically fit to go through rehab. I had to go through it and learn that about myself. And yeah, I mean, I wish I never got hurt. I mean, I'm if I'm being transparent, but I have gotten to the point where I've learned, you know, there's things that I can take away from that experience that will benefit me in life and through the rest of my career that I've I've grown to be thankful for.
quotes.pull_quote: Anytime you go through something that is traumatic like that, you you can't be the same person
quotes.news_angle: Jayson Tatum says he is thankful for the lessons learned during his injury recovery.
quotes.social_post: Jayson Tatum says he has grown to be thankful for the lessons he learned during his injury recovery process.

quotes.speaker: Jayson Tatum
quotes.text: I spent obviously a lot of time on the bench, right? And sitting next to the coaches for 65 some odd games, I really it really gave me a chance to see the game through their lens and the things that they pay attention to. And throughout every game, each coach is responsible for something different. And it was just kind of cool to see and I learned a lot. And I just kind of feel like the game slowed down for me even more so just kind of seeing it through their lens and how I can add that and translate to, you know, my own play when I'm out there.
quotes.news_angle: Jayson Tatum says sitting on the bench last season helped him see the game through the coaches lens.
quotes.social_post: Jayson Tatum says sitting on the bench for 65 games last season helped the game slow down for him by allowing him to see it through the coaches lens.
